summary: Implemented `PathNormalizationMiddleware`, a `AgentMiddleware` subclass that intercepts Deep Agents tool calls and rewrites Windows drive-letter paths to virtual `/`-rooted paths before `validate_path()` runs. The middleware is wired into every `create_deep_agent()` call in `src/nodes/__init__.py` and is a zero-cost no-op on macOS/Linux. All plan acceptance criteria are met: 25 new unit tests and 1 integration test were added, all passing alongside the full existing test suite (zero regressions).
